title: Toward Deconfounding the Influence of Entity Demographics for Question Answering Accuracy

bias_targets.methodology: Linking person entities in Question Answering (QA) datasets to Wikidata to extract gender, then using chi-square tests and logistic regression to determine if QA model accuracy correlates with the gender of the mentioned entity.

Linking person entities in QA datasets to Wikidata to extract nationality/country of origin, then using chi-square tests and logistic regression to evaluate if QA model accuracy varies based on the mentioned entity's nationality.

Linking person entities in QA datasets to Wikidata to extract professional field, then using chi-square tests and logistic regression to analyze if QA model accuracy correlates with the mentioned entity's occupation or profession.
